title: Super frustrating!
text: Super frustrating!. [[VIDEOID:32ffdcfcc0cc64566d64c0629b90eb80]] No instructions came with these so I had to look up a YouTube video from their manufacturer, Madison Park, to make sure I installed them correctly. Clicking the top mount into the brackets is nearly impossible and unless you are a preacher or a monk, you will find yourself cursing a lot. Make sure you are in the correct mindset before beginning. The bottom plastic plates snap together to keep the bottom from contorting. I only found this out thru the video. I needed only a drill and screwdriver. These are heavy. They are not light blocking. Installing 1 took about 45 minutes from start to finish. I am in the fence as to whether or not I’d order these again.

description: The Madison Park Eastfield Bamboo Light Filtering Roman Shade offers a natural and eco-friendly update to your home. This roman shade is made from a 100% bamboo woven material with unique variations in the color, for an organic look and feel. Overlapping bamboo slats provide a light filtering effect and enhanced privacy, while adding dimension and warmth to your room. This bamboo shade also features a cordless Lift/Pull Mechanism for easy daily use; while the brackets on the bottom can easily be snapped in to keep shades straight and secured in place. Please note: this bamboo shade does feature exposed cords on reverse for construction to connect natural slats; reverse images provided for reference. Ready to install right out of the packaging, this natural roman shade can be hung inside or above the window frame to give your window a clean, finished profile without dangling lift cords. The bamboo panel measures 64-inches long and comes in multiple width options to suit multiple standard window sizes. Using self-sustaining bamboo and other natural materials, each environmentally friendly roman shade is sold as a single unit and comes with hardware and a printed instructional guide. Assembly is required. Due to nature of material, colors and shade length may vary slightly and some stretch, shrink, and warpage may occur for any natural woven product. Natural woven materials can also be affected by temperature and humidity; mold may occur and should be vacuum cleaned as needed. Do not use any harsh chemicals or water to clean as natural bamboo material will be damaged over time from excessive moisture.
